newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO CETES RATE DOWN ON LIQUIDITY, STRONG PESO.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO CETES RATE DOWN ON LIQUIDITY, STRONG PESO.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates closed down 130 basis points at 17.00 percent on Wednesday on a strong peso and surplus market liquidity. "The market was awash in liquidity, as it normally is after the central bank cutoff. The peso was rock steady and that helped prevent a repetition of yesterday's spikes," a dealer said.
Wednesday saw the deadline for banks to settle oustanding balances on checking accounts held with Banco de Mexico.
Benchmark 48-hour peso contracts closed 2.6 centavos firmer at 7.7800/7.7830 per dollar.
